_comment: T1495: scenarios of tools/action_profile.py, derived from the table in docs/game-menus.md (owner description, not verified against code). The order is the order of a session. kind control = do nothing (the idle reference), action = do the ONE thing.

scenarios.title: Profile screen
scenarios.instruction: Open the profile list, scroll up and down through it, then back out. Do not create or delete a profile.

scenarios.title: Main Menu idle (control)
scenarios.instruction: Do NOTHING. Do not touch any button or the mouse.

scenarios.title: Main Menu navigate
scenarios.instruction: Move up and down through the main menu list. Do not select anything.

scenarios.title: Story list
scenarios.instruction: Open Story, scroll the level list up and down, do not start a level.

scenarios.title: Arcade mode list
scenarios.instruction: Scroll up and down through the game modes. Do not start one.

scenarios.title: League list
scenarios.instruction: Enter Amateur League and scroll through the maps. Do not start a match.

scenarios.title: Challenge list
scenarios.instruction: Scroll up and down through the challenge list. Do not start one.

scenarios.title: Xbox Live / System Link
scenarios.instruction: Open the entry and wait for its screen (offline: an error or no-network screen is expected), then back out.
scenarios.note: Skipped by default (crash reported before the T1496 repair, not re-checked for this entry). Run it with --only menu-live-syslink.

scenarios.title: Map Maker menu
scenarios.instruction: Scroll the Map Maker entries, select Load Map, look at the list, back out.

scenarios.title: Player Progress
scenarios.instruction: Open the stats page and leave it open.

scenarios.title: Controls
scenarios.instruction: Open the controls list, scroll up and down, back out. Do NOT open Audio/Video options here (own scenario menu-audio-video).

scenarios.title: Audio/Video options
scenarios.instruction: Open Audio/Video options, scroll down and up through EVERY option, change a few values (toggle one, move a volume slider a few steps), accept or apply, then back out to Settings. T1496 fixed the old crash.

scenarios.title: Audio/Video options reopen and leave
scenarios.instruction: Reopen Audio/Video options, check the changed values were kept, back out to Settings, then back out to the Main Menu.

scenarios.title: Extra: movies
scenarios.instruction: Open the movie list and scroll up and down. Do not play a movie.

scenarios.title: Extra: credits
scenarios.instruction: Select View credits and let them play.

scenarios.title: In-level idle (control)
scenarios.instruction: Stand still. Do not press any button and do not move the stick.

scenarios.title: In-level move
scenarios.instruction: Walk forward and look around only. Do not fire, reload or melee.

scenarios.title: Fire the pistol
scenarios.instruction: Fire the pistol only (hold or tap the fire button). Do not move, reload or melee.

scenarios.title: Reload
scenarios.instruction: Reload only, wait for the reload to finish, repeat if you can. Do not move or fire.

scenarios.title: Melee
scenarios.instruction: Melee only. Do not move or fire.

scenarios.title: Pause menu
scenarios.instruction: Open the pause menu, wait a moment, close it, repeat.

scenarios.title: Fight the first hostile enemies (AI census)
scenarios.starts_at: Story, within sight of the first HOSTILE enemies past the rebel base (T1240 frontier, docs/t-ai-enemy-encounter.md)
scenarios.instruction: Stay in sight of the hostile enemies. Let them see you, take cover and shoot back until they react to you (alert, chase, fire). Do not pause. The first rebels do not count: they are scripted friendlies.

scenarios.title: Walls, jump and grenade (collision census)
scenarios.starts_at: Story level 2401 (ingame-* all start at Story 2401), standing next to a wall with open floor to jump on (docs/t-physics-collide.md)
scenarios.instruction: Walk into a wall and slide along it, jump several times (also against the wall), then throw a grenade and watch it bounce. Do not pause.

scenarios.title: Story intro cutscene (cutscene census)
scenarios.starts_at: Story, the moment the Story level starts and the intro cutscene begins (docs/t-data-cutscene-scenario.md)
scenarios.instruction: Start Story from the menu and let the intro cutscene play from its first frame to the end without pressing anything. Do not skip it. Continue at the phase prompt just before you start Story. Stop when you get control of the character.

scenarios.title: Die
scenarios.starts_at: The death screen, after you were killed in Story 2401
scenarios.prelude: First get yourself killed (this part is NOT recorded, take your time). Do this last: it may end the level.
scenarios.instruction: Press Enter at the moment the death screen shows, then do NOTHING for 15 seconds.

scenarios.title: First Story objective (script array dump)
scenarios.starts_at: Story, in the first level right after you get control (docs/t-data-objective-scenario.md)
scenarios.instruction: Play the first Story objective to its end at your own pace (go where the game sends you, do what the objective asks). Continue at the phase prompt when you have control, press Enter again the moment the objective is complete (the objective text changes or the next scene starts). Pressing buttons is fine: each press is dumped too.
